signal: Windfall shipped Microsoft Dynamics, Affinaquest, and Bloomerang integrations, and raised $65M from Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital in April 2025.

email.body1:
Josh, saw Windfall keeps stacking integrations across Microsoft Dynamics, Affinaquest, and Bloomerang after the Morgan Stanley raise.

As the partner ecosystem grows, co-sell signals usually outpace what the team can act on, so partner-sourced accounts sit untouched. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the ecosystem, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Windfall's partner ecosystem off your integration and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Josh, quick follow-up for Windfall.

Partner-sourced pipeline usually stalls not on intent but on follow-up volume, the joint accounts pile up faster than anyone can write to them. That is exactly the gap an autonomous SDR closes.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them and how the co-sell motion would run?
email.body3:
Josh, last bit of proof for Windfall.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Windfall's partner-sourced reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Josh, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you build out the integrations, no problem at all. Timing matters as a partner program grows, and I know it keeps a BD team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ecosystem? I will tailor it to Windfall either way.
